text: Tasha: uploaded two prototypes for the billing list — 'memory-mode' (remembers last scope, compact rows with inline metadata) vs 'reveal-mode' (expanded cards showing actions). need quick takes before the design sync. Eli: drop the figma? Tasha: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/billing-memory-vs-reveal Marco: memory-mode is neat for returning users, but I worry new users won't find org-level invoices since scope can be persisted to a previous org. Yara: agree. defaulting to last-used scope is handy for power users, but confusing for admins who expect "All orgs". maybe show a subtle banner: "Showing invoices for: Acme Corp — Change scope" Suman: accessibility note: compact rows use shorthand like "14k" — VoiceOver reads that oddly. Suggest visible shorthand + sr-only full number (e.g., 14,000 tokens) or aria-label override. Tasha: good call. I'll add aria-labels and an sr-only number. Eli: on actions: where to put Download/Pay? memory-mode hides actions in kebab to keep density; reveal-mode puts them inline. proposal: show inline Pay only for invoices flagged overdue, leave Download in overflow unless user hovers. reduces accidental payments. Marco: +1 for overdue inline. add a micro-confirm for payments. Also add an undo toast after payment in case of misclick. Yara: keyboard nav: in compact rows the chevron to reveal details isn't in tab order. make the row focusable, add aria-expanded, and make Enter toggle reveal. Also ensure focus order is checkbox -> row -> kebab. Suman: color contrast check: overdue pill in dark theme is <4.5:1. need to bump the hue or increase weight. Also sparklines: if we add them, include aria-labels like "Usage trend last 30 days: increasing" and role=\"img\". mock-bot: Tasha uploaded updated mocks (memory-mode-v2, reveal-mode-v1) Tasha: updated: aria-labels for token counts, sr-only full numbers, overdue inline Pay for >30d, pay micro-confirm, undo toast, bumped overdue contrast, made rows keyboard-focusable, added optional mini-sparkline (non-interactive). trimmed expand animation to 100ms on mobile. Eli: looks much better. small nit: the kebab menu focus ring is faint on high-contrast themes. make it consistent with system focus style. Marco: analytics idea: pilot 3 weeks, 25% memory-mode, 25% reveal-mode, 50% control. measure: invoice_download_click, pay_initiated, pay_confirmed, undo_uses, support_tickets containing \"invoice\", avg_rows_expanded, and scope_change_clicks. Yara: also track keyboard-only flows: emit custom events when Enter toggles row and when Pay gains keyboard focus. helps us see accessibility usage. Suman: one more a11y nit: when bulk-download completes we should push an aria-live toast: "Bulk download ready: 4 files" so screen readers get feedback. Tasha: added that to the mocks and the acceptance checklist. will post final frames in ~30m and add the pilot to tomorrow's agenda (7m). Any blocking issues? Eli: none from engineering. payments team ok with micro-confirm + undo. Marco: none. Yara: nothing else. Tasha: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
